summary: Diagnostic verification of LIVE preview URL https://open-stack-app.preview.emergentagent.com/ (viewport 390x844). Test confirms the app renders end-to-end in the public URL: HTTP 200, first-contentful-paint 820ms, single JS bundle (~1236KB, 228ms), root #root receives 305 chars of content in ~1.02-1.76s, onboarding screen visible with 'MEET CHAMPION' brand header, jersey background, 'MEET THE LEGEND' logo, 'Trova il tuo campione' hero copy, pagination dots, and 'AVANTI' CTA button. No red screen, no JS pageerrors, no error boundary UI. Verified with default Chromium UA AND with an iOS Safari User-Agent header — both render identically. CONCLUSION: the live public URL is fully operational; the user's inability to see the preview is a client-side issue (browser cache, offline device, stale iframe embed, network/DNS block on their side, or expired preview session token in their browser). Recommend user: hard reload (Cmd+Shift+R / long-press reload on iOS), open the URL directly in a new Safari tab (not embedded iframe), disable content blockers, and confirm QR-code opened URL is exactly the one above. Non-blocking: 2 React-Native-Web deprecation warnings observed (shadow*, textShadow*).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and '"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".' — non-blocking but should be migrated. Location not pinpointed; likely in JerseyBackground.tsx or onboarding.tsx text/shadow styles.

action_items: No code fix required — server / bundle / preview URL are working correctly.

Inform user: issue is client-side. Ask them to (a) hard-refresh their browser, (b) open https://open-stack-app.preview.emergentagent.com/ in a fresh tab outside any iframe, (c) on phone, re-scan the QR code and ensure a working Wi-Fi/data connection, (d) try a different browser (Chrome on iOS uses WKWebView too, but a private/incognito window may bypass cached broken state).
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated 'shadow*' -> 'boxShadow' and 'textShadow*' -> 'textShadow' style props to silence React-Native-Web warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview URL is confirmed working. If user still reports blank preview, the next diagnostic step is to have them share (a) a screenshot of their preview iframe, (b) the exact URL shown in their address bar, and (c) devtools console errors. Do not touch metro.config.js, app.json, or babel.config.js.
rca_of_issue: No server-side issue. Diagnostic proves live URL responds 200 with a functional Expo web bundle that mounts React and renders the onboarding screen in ~1s FCP under both default and iOS Safari UAs. User's 'no preview' complaint originates on their client: most likely a stale/cached page, an iframe embed that lost its auth/session cookie, an offline phone, or a network/content-blocker intercepting the preview host. Mitigation: hard reload, incognito, open URL directly, verify network connectivity.
